task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Bring the black stapler with rectangular base to the right position of the rounded rectangular blue soap bar.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高度稳定性，不变形，进入框架将矩形底座的黑色订书机带到圆角矩形蓝色皂条的正确位置。
